purpose: Public commits that pin the GitHub actions of the workflows, and the published root of this repository. A 40-character identifier is admitted by the publication gate only in the exact form owner/repository@<commit> listed here; the published history must run linearly from published_root except for the reviewed historical merges and exact parents pinned here and sealed in code. All reachable objects, including both parent histories, remain checked; no other merge or additional root is admitted. distribution_baseline pins the already-public reviewed file inventory; its actual tree and every later reachable tree receive the shared exact-set check.
